evidence_note: These are reviewer test definitions and expected behaviors for version 1.2.0. They are not executed-result evidence. Populate actual_result_summary and evidence_reference only after running the exact packaged version.

positive.title: Natural Corporate Documentary Generation
positive.prompt: Here is a clear photo of our CEO. Direct a believable unposed partnership-signing image in a modern office.
positive.expected_behavior: Classifies generate_new_scene and documentary-corporate, preserves visible appearance from the identity-role reference, directs readable signing context and restrained professional capture, compiles an engine-ready packet, and requires actual image evidence before QA approval.
positive.expected_result_shape: Direction packet plus engine execution packet; visual QA only after output exists

positive.title: Distant Ordinary Phone Candid
positive.prompt: Make this look like a friend photographed me randomly from about 12 meters away on a normal Egyptian beach. Keep me full-body and small in the frame.
positive.expected_behavior: Selects everyday-lifestyle + phone-candid + distant-candid, keeps the subject small with distance-consistent detail, uses ordinary beach context and normal phone depth, and avoids luxury/tropical replacement or extreme portrait blur.
positive.expected_result_shape: Distance-aware scene direction and execution packet

positive.title: Multi-Reference Role Mapping
positive.prompt: Photo 1 is me, photo 2 is the jacket I want, and photo 3 is the office I want to use. Make a natural professional image.
positive.fixture_required: Three images representing identity, wardrobe, and environment
positive.expected_behavior: Maps the three assets to identity, wardrobe, and environment roles explicitly, keeps role boundaries through compilation, and does not blend every input as generic style inspiration.
positive.expected_result_shape: Reference-role map plus direction and execution packet

positive.title: GPT Image 2.5 Preservation-Sensitive Edit
positive.prompt: Use GPT Image 2.5 to change only the jacket. Preserve my visible appearance, expression, pose, crop, light and background because those details cannot drift.
positive.fixture_required: One existing image to edit and, when needed, an identity/wardrobe reference
positive.expected_behavior: Classifies edit_existing_image, creates explicit CHANGE and PRESERVE sets, selects Sunburst when precision/preservation requirements justify it, keeps model/quality/size/background/format as request controls rather than prompt decoration, and requires edit-drift QA on the output.
positive.expected_result_shape: GPT Image 2.5 edit packet with model rationale, request parameters, prompt, and QA requirements

positive.title: Visual QA and Bounded Revision
positive.prompt: Audit this generated photo. The right hand looks malformed and the skin looks artificially smooth. Fix only what the image evidence justifies.
positive.fixture_required: An actual generated photo; identity reference if likeness is being judged
positive.expected_behavior: Reviews only observable gates, classifies the specific failures, chooses a bounded local repair when appropriate, carries a preserve set, and never marks comparison-dependent gates PASS without the needed image/reference evidence.
positive.expected_result_shape: Evidence-linked QA report plus revision packet when needed

negative.title: Anime/Fantasy Boundary
negative.prompt: Turn my selfie into an anime warrior with magical glowing armor.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke the natural-photography workflow as the primary solution because the requested medium is non-photographic.
negative.expected_result_shape: Boundary/fallback rather than Lively photographic direction

negative.title: Promotional Poster Boundary
negative.prompt: Create a sale poster with large 3D headline text, a CTA badge, floating icons and my portrait.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not treat a typography-led promotional graphic as a natural-photography job.

negative.title: Product-Only Image Boundary
negative.prompt: Remove the background from this product-only packshot and make it transparent.
negative.fixture_required: Product image with no real-person photography job
negative.expected_behavior: Does not trigger Lively Photos Director when the task is a product-only image edit with no human photographic direction requirement.
negative.expected_result_shape: Use a general image-editing workflow instead
